description: This file defines the class Image_Graph_Dataset_Function, which provides a dataset implementation for functions in the Image_Graph PHP library. It supports generating points from a mathematical function, primarily for graphing purposes.

classes.name: Image_Graph_Dataset_Function
classes.description: A dataset class for generating points from a mathematical function, used in the Image_Graph PHP graphing library.

methods.name: Image_Graph_Dataset_Function
methods.description: Constructor method initializing the dataset with a range, function name, and point count.

methods.name: addPoint
methods.description: Method intended to add a point to the dataset but is empty as points are generated by the function.

methods.name: _getPointY
methods.description: Computes the Y value for a given X by applying the specified function.

methods.name: _count
methods.description: Returns the total number of points to generate.

methods.name: _stepX
methods.description: Calculates the interval between X values based on the range and number of points.

methods.name: _calculateMaxima
methods.description: Computes the minimum and maximum Y values across the generated points to determine extrema.
